_about: Every number the five-link judge (kimodo_vla/agent/judge.py) uses. The draft values were written before any experiment-3 episode was looked at and are not tuned on outcomes; the user fixed them as they are on 2026-11-28 (status 'fixed 2026-11-28 (draft value)'), and changed only the P&PBox placement rule to the 5 s reading (place_hold_s, place_window_steps, place_hands_off_n; decision in experiment3/README.md). Distances in metres, angles in degrees, forces in newtons, times in seconds.
_status: fixed 2026-11-28 (user: the draft values as they are, not tuned on outcomes; only the P&PBox placement rule changed, place_hold_s)

box_size_m.meaning: Edge of the P&PBox box (Arena, move_pickplace_box .../mdp/rewards.py _BOX_SIZE_M).

collision_force_n.meaning: A robot body other than the feet, ankles, hands and wrists pressing on anything with at least this force during a reach counts as a collision.

collision_min_s.meaning: A contact counts as a collision only when it lasts at least this long. Before any attempt (approach) hands and wrists count too.

stable_tilt_max_deg.meaning: Largest pelvis tilt from upright allowed during a reach.

reach_region_pad_m.meaning: Padding added on every side of the box region validated in the first batch (configs/grasp-loop.json stand.region, both yaws pooled) before the reach margin is measured.

reach_margin_min_m.meaning: Smallest reach margin (box region and each arm) that counts as reachable; negative margins are outside.

grasp_face_gap_m.meaning: Commanded wrist distance outside the box face on its side (negative: inside the box), robot-aligned box frame.

grasp_forward_m.meaning: Commanded wrist position along the face, from the box centre, along the robot's facing direction.

grasp_height_m.meaning: Commanded wrist height relative to the box centre.

palm_angle_max_deg.meaning: Largest angle between the commanded palm direction and the direction into the box from that hand's side.

place_bottom_gap_m.meaning: Placement: where the commanded wrists would put the box bottom, relative to the target layer's top.

wrist_arrival_m.meaning: Measured wrist position off the commanded one, at the end of the command.

wrist_arrival_deg.meaning: Measured wrist orientation off the commanded one, at the end of the command.

root_arrival_m.meaning: P&PBox: measured root off the target of the last walk before a stage (pick or place), at its end.

yaw_arrival_deg.meaning: P&PBox: measured heading off the target of the last turn (or walk) before a stage, at its end.

pelvis_arrival_m.meaning: Measured pelvis off the commanded pelvis target (ground distance, and height separately), at the end of the sit command.

lifted_height_m.meaning: Box raised at least this much above where it rested at the start counts as lifted (the first batch's grasp success used 0.10 m).

support_window_s.meaning: Window after the sit command in which the seat must carry the hips.

support_force_n.meaning: Median contact force on the pelvis and hip bodies over that window (Arena's own success check needs 5 N on one body).

place_hold_s.meaning: P&PBox success and the place stage's link 4: this long after a hand-opening command the box must still be on the target (Arena's on-shelf check) with both hands off it. Replaces place_settle_s (1 s, Arena's check at any moment), which counted a box falling past the shelf as placed.

place_window_steps.meaning: Arena's on-shelf check (logged every 0.1 s) must hold on every sample within this many logged steps of that moment (as exp3_release_check.py reads it).

place_hands_off_n.meaning: At that moment each hand presses the box with less than this (the box contact sensor's per-hand force).

dropped_drift_m.meaning: After lifting and before the hands open, the box's offset from the midpoint of the two wrists changing by more than this counts as lost (slipped or knocked out of the hands).

sit_height_max_m.meaning: A pelvis_height command at or below this height (or with behind_feet_m) is a sit attempt.

sit_facing_max_deg.meaning: Largest angle between the robot's backward direction and the direction to the seat centre when it starts to sit.

sit_entry_distance_m.meaning: Distance behind the pelvis to the seat box's edge, when it starts to sit.

seat_margin_min_m.meaning: The commanded pelvis target at least this far inside the seat box (ground plane).

sit_height_above_seat_m.meaning: Commanded pelvis height above the seat top.
